title: LINJA
description: A departure board for the work. Every letter and picture is a field of flipping discs; Morse is another way in.
signature: 6,912 instanced discs flip in a spring-driven wave. A 60 ms Morse key decodes work, contact and help; mechanical sound is opt-in.
holdback: The board scrolls away while lower timetable rows are previewed; large glyphs are scaled 5×7 letters and look blocky.
